result.summary: The page has one prominent visual defect: a broken/missing restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section that renders a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon. Otherwise the layout appears largely intact.

issues.description: The restaurant card for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section displays a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of the actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset URL is valid and reachable, add a fallback image, or hide the image area gracefully until the asset loads.
